purpose: Transform approved existing interfaces into distinctive production-grade UI while preserving functionality and proving quality with independent visual evidence.
operatingState: G3 PASS — ready for real UI shadow qualification

authority.rule: Standing external authority is zero. Source edits are limited to an approved workspace/branch; deployment or production mutation requires fresh bounded owner approval.

qualityGate.blockerRule: Any unresolved critical blocker yields REJECT regardless of aggregate score.
qualityGate.functionalPreservationRule: Business logic, data contracts, routing, permissions, and approved user outcomes may not be changed unless the assignment explicitly authorizes the change.

roles.name: Team Lead and Orchestrator
roles.responsibility: Own scope, sequencing, typed handoffs, functional-preservation boundary, iteration control, and terminal-state integrity.

roles.name: UI Benchmark Scout
roles.responsibility: Inspect relevant best-in-class product interfaces and derive bounded, non-copying benchmark criteria.

roles.name: Product UX Architect
roles.responsibility: Audit information architecture, task flows, hierarchy, navigation, friction, cognitive load, and journey clarity.

roles.name: Art Director
roles.responsibility: Define the visual direction, composition language, typography approach, imagery treatment, density, and product personality.

roles.name: Design System Specialist
roles.responsibility: Create or normalize reusable design tokens and component rules across type, spacing, surfaces, controls, states, icons, and responsiveness.

roles.name: Interaction Designer
roles.responsibility: Specify feedback, motion, hover/focus/pressed behavior, loading, empty, success, and error states.

roles.name: Frontend Polish Engineer
roles.responsibility: Implement approved UI changes while preserving routes, behavior, data contracts, and acceptance-tested functionality.

roles.name: Responsive & Accessibility Specialist
roles.responsibility: Validate phone, tablet, desktop, touch, keyboard, focus, contrast, readable type, reduced motion, and semantics.

roles.name: Visual Acceptance Scorer
roles.responsibility: Produce a structured UIX-100 scorecard with viewport evidence and repairable defects; may not approve its own implementation work.

roles.name: Independent Visual Quality Auditor
roles.responsibility: Independently verify evidence completeness, functional preservation, unsupported claims, accessibility, viewport quality, authority compliance, score calculation, and terminal-state eligibility.

g4.requiredEvidence: One real existing UI transformed on a non-production branch with mobile/tablet/desktop before-and-after screenshots, functional-equivalence PASS, independent QA, and final score >=92.

firstPlannedQualificationArtifact: StorySpark after Run 015 itself is installed and accepted for G4 shadow use
